test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly differentiates a cutting blowpipe/torch from a welding blowpipe/torch?

options.text: A cutting blowpipe has 3 control valves, while a welding blowpipe has 1.
A cutting blowpipe has 1 control valve, while a welding blowpipe has 2 control valves.
A cutting blowpipe has 2 control valves and 1 lever, while a welding blowpipe has 2 control valves.
A cutting blowpipe has 2 levers, while a welding blowpipe has 1 lever.

solution:
The correct answer is __A cutting blowpipe has 2 control valves and 1 lever, while a welding blowpipe has 2 control valves.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cutting blowpipe__ has two control valves and an additional lever for cutting action.
 
• The lever controls the high-pressure oxygen jet used for cutting metal.
 
• __Welding blowpipe__ has two control valves to regulate the flow of fuel gas and oxygen.
 
• It is used for joining metals by creating a molten pool.
 
• Cutting torches are designed for cutting metal, while welding torches are designed for heating and joining metal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cutting Blowpipe:**

 
 
• Used for cutting through metals like steel using a high-pressure oxygen jet.
 
• Requires a fuel gas and oxygen mixture for preheating the metal.
 
 
 
• **Welding Blowpipe:**
 
 
• Designed to produce a flame suitable for melting and joining metals.
 
• Operates with a balanced oxygen and fuel gas mixture.
